invalidation.affectedPaths: All PNG level1/6/9 token output and deflater instance scalar size. Stored encoding gains no token code; its already-historical displayed costs remainH. Decode/inspection, JPEG/WebP, editing/text paths unchanged.

decision.reason: A coherent operation-local complete-token/word-drain writer establishes a useful independent raw Fastest8 gain with separated raw confidence and exact packets. Conservative normalized intervals narrowly overlap; acceptance does not claim independently separated normalized gain or standalone parity. Word native-clock movement prevents a causal broader CPU claim. Eight extra allocated bytes per operation and no substantial capacity growth are acceptable.
